environment: local x86-64; disposable PostgreSQL18/Redis DB15; pg_stat_statements track=all and track_planning=on
method: Actual baseline/current resolver and whole tagged ingestion, same seeded shapes and fake HTTP/language output on both sides. PostgreSQL stats reset immediately before target; SQLAlchemy engine/pool events track app calls, FOR UPDATE statements, transaction and checkout lifetime. Prefetch GET+decode precedes SQL; compression/publication follows connection check-in. Primary cohort retains ordinary autovacuum; CPU includes fixed cgroup-read probes/background maintenance. Secondary quiet cohort disables autovacuum only in its owned disposable PG container, checkpoints before samples, and repeats3 times/side; CPU is not isolated backend CPU and does not prove equivalence.
production_enable_gate: Keep feature default off until native ARM64 realistic concurrent workload canary establishes PostgreSQL CPU/slot budgets; local audit proves structural work boundaries, not universal zero-cost behavior.
